labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip: event frame = first frame whose centre (960, 540) shows the other side of the surface; crossing = frames in between. Exits pass through a phase where the dome is half out of the water (sharp circular waterline rim, centre in a brownish band below the sky): crossing_first = first frame where the rim is sharp (judgement, it forms gradually), event = first frame with sky at the centre. Entries: crossing = foam / water sheet over the lens; event = first frame with under-water bubble froth or dark water at the centre.
